description: A rule on the recent past of any market the lab reads, against a coin flip, after its costs. Free, instant and never signed: a rule can be fitted to history.

market.description: crypto, tradfi (stocks, indexes, commodities), defi (protocols' tokens), yield (pools), pegs (stablecoins) or events (prediction markets)

volumeMultiple.description: The hour's notional over the last day's mean

when.description: Conditions on the market's readings; all must hold

changeHours.description: Hours over which it moved, in percent; leave out to compare its level

signal.description: A reading the market has: price, funding, tvl, fees, apy, stable, stables, iv or left. Which market has which is in opsin_perps
